S.press.title: Ngwugwu ndị nta akụkọ Lewydo
S.press.lead: Ihe niile ị chọrọ iji dee banyere Lewydo ma ọ bụ mee vidio banyere egwuregwu anyị: eziokwu ndị dị mkpa, akụkọ anyị, akara anyị na ngwugwu ndị nta akụkọ nke egwuregwu anyị. Jiri ya n'efu n'ihe ị na-ebipụta.

S.studio.title: Mmadụ abụọ, otu obi
S.cp:about: Lewydo bụ obere studio egwuregwu nke mmadụ abụọ si Ukraine. Vlad na-ede koodu, Lilya na-ahazi ọdịdị. Anyị abụọ na-eme egwuregwu ndị anyị n'onwe anyị hụrụ n'anya igwu.
S.story.brand.d: Vlad na-emechi edemede ya niile na [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) gbasara LibGDX, Android na Kotlin n'otu ụzọ: «Love what you do» na obi akwụkwọ ndụ 💚. Mbinye aka ahụ ghọrọ akara anyị.
S.story.3.d: Onye na-emepụta zutere onye nhazi. Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ amabeghị na ọ dị.
S.story.idea.d: Vlad na-arụ ọrụ n'Ụsụ Agha Ukraine. Otu ụtụtụ, ọ tetara n'ụlọ ebe otu ndị agha ya nọ n'oge ọrụ — echiche CubePix dị ya n'isi.
S.press.games.sub: Egwuregwu ọ bụla nwere ngwugwu ndị nta akụkọ nke ya na foto ihuenyo, trela na eziokwu.
S.od.tag: Okirikiri abụọ. Otu mpịa. Mwụli ọ bụla n'oge egwu.
S.pk.line.orbitdash: Egwuregwu ụda egwu na mbara igwe dị omimi: otu mpịa na-agbanwe okirikiri, mwụli ọ bụla na-adakwasị n'ụda egwu nke anyị onwe anyị.

S.press.logo.title: Akara Lewydo
S.press.logo.sub: PNG ndị doro anya, si ozugbo n'egwuregwu anyị. Biko debe akara ahụ n'azụ gbara ọchịchịrị, ghara ịgbanwe agba ma ọ bụ nha ya.
S.press.kit: **Ngwugwu akara dum**: iwu, agba, ụdị mkpụrụedemede, ụda Lewydo na koodu maka egwuregwu anyị.
